info.title: Envelope API
info.description: Declarative OpenAPI slice: document CRUD, audit history/rollback/restore, the IAM account routes, secret staging, document import/export, and the platform operator surfaces (managed indexes, artifact administration, system settings). Roles are iam.Roles documents served by the document CRUD routes. Response shapes are described in doc/backend/*.md; the path/method set here is validated against the live Kemal route table. Three surfaces stay out by decision: MCP (/Api/_mcp/...) is the agent data plane, not an API surface; OAuth (/OAuth/...) and the assistant (/Api/assistant/...) are outside the declarative slice.

get.description: Paginated, filtered, sorted list in `{ data, meta }` form. `?deleted=true` switches to the trash listing. ETag validators apply. `403` — the caller holds no read permission on the doctype at all; a read grant always yields the (possibly empty) scope-narrowed list.

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

304.description: Not modified — the ETag matched (see doc/backend/http-layer.md, HTTP caching).

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

post.description: Creates a document and returns it in `{ data, meta }` form. `409` is doctype-registration specific: a duplicate `(domain, doctype)` on `core.DocType`.

201.description: Created — the stored document in `{ data, meta }` form.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — RBAC denial, or the write-plane refusals: `Write refused: invisible field` and `Role authority refused this write` (IAM doctypes).

x-query.description: Same list as GET with the parameters in a JSON body only — query-string parameters answer `422`, a non-JSON body media type answers `415`. The `403` matches the GET list: no read permission on the doctype at all.

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

get.description: Single-document read in `{ data, meta }` form; lazy migration applies on read. ETag validators apply. `403` — no read permission on the doctype at all. `404` — the document is missing, or invisible to a caller that holds a read grant (non-disclosing: an inaccessible document is indistinguishable from a missing one). `410` marks a delete tombstone.

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

304.description: Not modified — the ETag matched (see doc/backend/http-layer.md, HTTP caching).

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

410.description: Gone — the document is a delete tombstone (`X-Document-Deleted: true`).

patch.description: JSON merge patch (RFC 7386): `null` removes a key. Returns the updated document in `{ data, meta }` form. A scoped update grant whose row check fails answers `404` — an inaccessible document is indistinguishable from a missing one; `403` is the class-level denial (no update permission on the doctype at all).

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

Every row carries the out-of-band `redacted` metadata — the content paths removed from `arguments` for the calling principal; no `__redacted__` markers enter the content itself. `?include=children` merges readable child rows into the timeline. `403` — no read permission on the doctype at all; `404` — a grant holder cannot see the document (non-disclosing).

Referrer rows stay inside each doctype's list visibility. `items` caps the result (server max 1000).

post.summary: Stage a secret value out of band
post.description: Stores the value in `secret_staging` and answers `{ handle, token? }`. The handle is single-use and TTL-bound; the client puts it into the document instead of the value. `403` — the caller is the system principal or an API key (a handle is a session-bound capability), the session has no `X-Requested-With` header, or the caller holds neither `create` on the doctype nor `update` on the `doc_id` it names. `404` (non-disclosing) — unknown doctype, a field path that is not a `secret` leaf, a `view` tag the caller cannot see, or an unknown secret mode. `422` — missing or invalid body, plaintext rejected by the definition's `min`/`max`/`pattern`, or a value supplied for a server-generated `token` secret.

201.description: Created — the stored document in `{ data, meta }` form.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the system principal and API keys never stage a secret (a handle is user-bound), a cookie session without the `X-Requested-With` header fails the CSRF check, or the caller holds neither `create` on the doctype nor `update` on the named document.

post.description: Validates `?format=` (`csv` or `json`) and the filter parameters against the definition, enqueues a `document_export` job, and answers `202` with `{ job_id, status_url }`. `?wait=true` polls the job and streams the file instead (the timeout falls back to the `202` body). `422` — unknown or missing format, a reserved parameter (`sort`, `page`, `per_page`, `items`, `wait` handled, `format` handled), preview mode, a `member_of` or `sidecar` doctype, or a malformed filter. `404` — unknown doctype. `403` — no read permission on the doctype at all.

202.description: Accepted — the job is queued; the body carries its id and status URL.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no read permission on the doctype at all (the list route's class-level gate, so a doomed job is never queued).

post.description: Exports the named columns in the caller's sort and filter order. The structured payload rides a JSON body; the response is the export enqueue body (`202` with `{ job_id, status_url }`, or the streamed CSV on `?wait=true`). `415` — the body does not declare a JSON media type. `422` — a query parameter other than `wait`, a non-object or malformed body, missing / empty / duplicate / unknown `columns`, a malformed `sort`, a non-object `filters`, an invalid `timezone`, preview mode, a `member_of` or `sidecar` doctype, or a filter that does not compile. `404` — unknown doctype. `403` — no read permission on the doctype at all.

202.description: Accepted — the job is queued; the body carries its id and status URL.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no read permission on the doctype at all.

post.summary: Upload a file to import as documents
post.description: Parses and validates the uploaded file synchronously, stores the file and its row-to-id manifest as artifacts, enqueues a `document_import` job, and answers `202` with the job id and the row count. `?wait=true` polls the job and answers the upsert report (`200`), the failing row (`422`), or the job id on a crash (`500`). `413` — the upload exceeds `artifact.max_upload_bytes`. `422` — no body, an undetectable format, a malformed row or header, preview mode, or a `member_of` / `sidecar` doctype. `404` — unknown doctype. `403` — no read permission on the doctype at all.

202.description: Accepted — the job is queued; the body carries its id and status URL.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no read permission on the doctype at all.

413.description: Payload too large — the upload exceeds `artifact.max_upload_bytes`.

get.summary: Read an import or export job status
get.description: Caller-facing job outcome in `{ id, status, error, result }` form. `result` is null while the row is pending or running. Requester-scoped: another account's job, an unknown job, or a job of another kind or doctype answers the non-disclosing `404`.

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

get.description: Streams the export bytes with the stored MIME type and an attachment filename (`{domain}.{doctype}[.view].{format}`). Only a succeeded export produces a file: a pending, running, or failed job, an import job, a pruned artifact, another account's job, and an unknown job all answer the non-disclosing `404`.

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

get.description: One row per physical PostgreSQL partial index the `Index::Manager` owns, with its lifecycle status, in `{ data, meta }` form. The path is a pseudo-doctype: indexes span every domain. Strict admission — a query parameter outside the list grammar answers `422` naming it; an unknown filter field or operator also answers `422`. `403` — the caller holds no wildcard `read` (`*.*`).

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no wildcard `read` (`*.*`) operator permission.

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

delete.description: Security deletion: destroys the artifact row, its storage object, and every child row by cascade, and writes an `iam.ArtifactEvent` audit document. `404` — unknown artifact. `422` — a malformed JSON body. The optional `{ "reason": "…" }` body is stored on the audit event.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller is neither the system principal nor holds the `purge *.*` operator action, or a cookie session sent no `X-Requested-With` header.

get.summary: List the grants of one artifact
get.description: Every grant minted against the artifact, newest first, in `{ data, meta }` form. The listing caps at `Artifact::Admin::SUB_LIST_CAP` (500) and reports `more` on the meta. `404` — unknown artifact. `403` — the caller holds no wildcard `read` (`*.*`).

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no wildcard `read` (`*.*`) operator permission.

get.summary: List the documents that reference one artifact
get.description: The `artifact_references` rows joined with the referencing document's projection, newest first, in `{ data, meta }` form. The listing caps at `Artifact::Admin::SUB_LIST_CAP` (500) and reports `more` on the meta. `404` — unknown artifact. `403` — the caller holds no wildcard `read` (`*.*`).

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no wildcard `read` (`*.*`) operator permission.

get.description: The operator read the settings page uses: `{ values, pinned }` — the effective non-secret values keyed by path, and the paths the settings document currently pins. Secret paths are absent; no credential material leaves through this surface. A missing settings document is tolerated (every key follows the file). `403` — the caller holds no read permission on the `core.SystemSettings` doctype (the seed posture is admin-only).

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no read permission on the `core.SystemSettings` doctype.

post.summary: Send a test email through the saved mail connector
post.description: The settings page's test action. One blocking delivery through the **saved** connector — the effective document-over-file mail settings, the same path a password reset or an invite takes. Pending edits in the form do not participate. Answers `{ adapter, from_address, to }` on success. `422` — `mail.adapter` is `dev` (the "none (no email)" posture — it prints to stdout and delivers nothing) or `to` is missing or malformed. `502` — the transport failed; the message carries the adapter's own error (refused connection, authentication failure), which is the diagnostic the operator pressed the button for. `403` — the caller holds no update permission on the `core.SystemSettings` doctype.

200.description: Success — JSON body per the response shape noted on the operation.

401.description: Authentication required — missing or invalid credential.

403.description: Forbidden — the caller holds no update permission on the `core.SystemSettings` doctype.

502.description: Upstream failure — a remote dependency refused or failed the request; the message carries its own error.
